steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Vikunja with username 'admin' and password 'bench-admin-pass'. After signing in, confirm you are logged in and report the name of the user shown in the top-right / user menu.

02-open: Open the project named 'Bench Project' in Vikunja and list the titles of all tasks whose title starts with 'Seed:' exactly as displayed. Do not modify anything. Report each title verbatim, one per line.

03-create: In the project 'Bench Project' in Vikunja, create a new task with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Task' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task created for run {{runid}}'). Fill the description in the task creation form or on the task detail page, whichever the app supports. After creating it, open the task's detail page and report: the task title as displayed, the description text as displayed, the task's identifier exactly as the app displays it on the task page (Vikunja shows it as BENCH-<number>), and the URL.

04-set: On the Vikunja task detail page for the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (identifier {{03-create.task_identifier}}, at /tasks/{{03-create.url.p1}}), set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 and its priority to 'High'. The page edits fields in place and saves automatically when changed or when you leave the field — there is no overall Save button. After setting both, reload the task page and report the due date and priority exactly as displayed.

05-create: On the Vikunja task detail page for the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (identifier {{03-create.task_identifier}}, at /tasks/{{03-create.url.p1}}), attach the EXISTING label named 'Backend' to the task. Important: the label field creates a NEW label from whatever text is typed unless an existing label is chosen from its suggestions — so type 'Backend' into the label field, wait for the suggestion dropdown, and click the existing 'Backend' label from the suggestions (do NOT just press Enter on typed text, which would create a duplicate new label). After attaching, reload the task page and report the name of the label(s) shown on the task, exactly as displayed.

06-add: On the Vikunja task detail page for the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (identifier {{03-create.task_identifier}}, at /tasks/{{03-create.url.p1}}), add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment. After posting, reload the task page and report the comment text exactly as displayed on the task page.

07-open: Final verification, read-only, do not modify anything. Open the Vikunja task page at /tasks/{{03-create.url.p1}} and report exactly as displayed: (a) the task title, (b) the task identifier (BENCH-<number>), (c) the description text, (d) the due date, (e) the priority, (f) the label(s) attached, (g) the comment text and author. Then open the project 'Bench Project' list view and report the titles of all tasks shown, verbatim, and confirm none of the tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:' were modified.
